title: Tour: Manage Scoring
blurb: Give contacts points for actions so you can spot hot leads.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Manage Scoring
steps.body: Click **Manage Scoring** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: What scoring does
steps.body: Scoring adds or takes away points when a contact does something, like opening an email or booking a call. Higher scores mean warmer leads.

steps.title: Your rules
steps.body: The table lists each rule and its points. Green adds points, red takes them away.

steps.title: Add a rule
steps.body: **Add New Rule** creates a new scoring rule.

steps.title: Draft and publish
steps.body: Changes start as a draft. Use the draft and publish switch in the top right to make them live.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Set up lead scoring rules** from the Guide.
